paragraphs: The Old Town Walk: Our Plan, posted by Lily. Dear parents and friends of the Explorers. Our next trip is a tour of the old town trail. Many buildings in the old town are more than a century old. Teacher Kim says, "It is an excellent trip for the club." It is a big day for us. Please read the plan, and sign the note.

Where: the old town trail. When: Saturday, the twenty-sixth of December. We are meeting at the school gate at eight o'clock. The bus leaves at a quarter past eight. We arrive in the old town at nine o'clock. A guide from the town museum meets us at the first old house. The guide knows all the old stories. We will listen carefully.

The walk takes two hours, and the trail is not long. It seems easy, but the path has many small stones. We will stop at five old houses. The old town is quiet on Saturday morning. At eleven o'clock, we sit in a small garden and eat our snack. At a quarter past eleven, we go back to the bus. The bus returns to school at twelve o'clock. Parents can pick up their children at the school gate at a quarter past twelve.

What to bring: Every child must pack a small bag. A big bag is too heavy for a long walk. Please put in a mug for juice, a bottle of water, and a snack. Wear a hat and comfortable shoes. Bring a notebook and a pencil, too. Mia will take the photos, and Leo will draw the old houses.

The transport is free, because the school pays for the bus. Please sign the note and give it to Teacher Kim by Wednesday. If it rains, we will not go, and we will meet in the library. Teacher Kim will send a message to every parent by seven o'clock that morning. Do you have any questions? Please write to me on the blog. Thank you for your help. We cannot wait! Best wishes, Lily.
